errors.evidence: Description states the LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit ends at approximately +0.5% at Layer29-32, while the figure shows it is closer to +1%.
Description indicates the RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit reaches its lowest point of approximately -14.7%, while the figure shows it is closer to -15%.
